gameplay.core_loop: 玩家以独立居民身份沿不可穿越建筑的道路导航网步行并进入建筑 → 与固定主理人 Luna、居民 NPC 和 AI 分身分别互动 → 抵达功能热点 → 经营单主 KPI Campaign → 完成合规与测量决策 → 生成并提交本地玩法证据 → 获得无价值模拟经营金与运营评级 → 在主题飞机经过时点击领取本地纪念 Token，并同步获得 5 枚无价值虚拟砖块 → 在本地钱包查看收藏和账本 → 查看外部 KPI 仍为未确认

local visual navigation only; no geolocation or external request

local rules only; no raw transcript retention

local proof complete; simulated no-value settlement only; external KPI remains unconfirmed

scoring.rule: Each unique completed task grants 20–45 virtual bricks and 25–40 prosperity; upgrade consumes local bricks only.

runtime_policy.fallback_behavior: If localhost API is unavailable, allow guest browser-only gameplay and bounded in-browser KOL chat rules, but block local account, invite binding and demo-card redemption; never enable external CTA or real reward. Raw chat text is never persisted.

telemetry.deduplication_strategy: Generate one event_id per local emission and enforce SQLite uniqueness. Local alias registration_complete is not an external exchange registration. External KPIs require independent approved server-side deduplication and confirmation.
telemetry.consent_behavior: Guest events use a pseudonymous guest session. Local alias registration requires explicit local-storage consent. KOL AI chat text is processed on localhost or in browser memory and discarded; telemetry stores only intent, length, mode and safety outcome. Persist only allowed data to localhost SQLite; remote analytics is disabled.

build.dependency_lock: Static local HTML/CSS/JavaScript + consistent isometric interior renders reused by the Campaign Lab lifecycle overview + optimized AVIF/WebP derivatives + vendored MIT-licensed Web3 Icons HT.svg + bundled Cubism SDK for Web 5-r.5 runtime and Mao sample; Python server is an optional same-origin file host; no runtime network dependency

notes: Version 0.16.2 replaces the flat Campaign Lab lifecycle SVG at runtime with the same high-fidelity isometric growth-center scene, materials, lighting and compact hotspot language used by the main town and building interiors; all five lifecycle filters and six Campaign rules are unchanged.
The Campaign Lab route marker now renders the saved resident look and player name instead of presenting the player as Luna.

Version 0.15.1 increases the complete draggable town world canvas from 146% to 176%, creating visibly larger spacing between buildings while preserving one shared coordinate system for scene art, road nodes, character paths and building hotspots.
Version 0.15.0 adds bounded pointer, touch and keyboard panning, a recenter control and drag-click suppression.
Map panning is local visual navigation and does not change Campaign, reward, CTA, external KPI or commercial fields.

Version 0.13.0 replaces the flat CSS clouds with optimized volumetric cloud sprites, redraws the outdoor road graph against the current map, adds foot-anchored full-body Luna walking and depth-aware NPC gait, and adds a three-drop Huobi-themed commemorative Token sky event.

The Huobi-themed plane and collectible contain no copied brand logo asset and do not imply authorization; every collectible is browser-local with monetary_value=0, external_confirmation=false, transferable=false and withdrawable=false.
Version 0.12.2 replaces the growth-center interior SVG with a portrait isometric cutaway render matched to the other seven building interiors; navigation, hotspots and Campaign logic are unchanged.
Version 0.12.1 adds tap, D-pad and keyboard navigation to all eight layered 2.5D interiors.
The authored growth campus SVG is retained as a rollback asset but is no longer referenced by runtime.
Large town, interior and avatar atlases have AVIF-first and WebP-second runtime derivatives with original files retained as fallbacks.
Luna local rules now answer from current Campaign, lifecycle stage, unfinished decisions, KPI source and next action, and refuse requests to change Contract-locked fields.
Each Campaign contains one primary KPI, three deterministic decisions, one local proof and an explicit external confirmation source.
External KPI confirmation is fail-closed and remains zero in this build.
Deposit and trade marketing require separate legal, compliance and risk approval before production use.
The current renderer uses official sample Mao and labels it as not Luna; production Luna model creation and authorization remain out of scope.
